description: Add or remove labels on specific messages, or on every message of a thread. This is how to mark read (remove UNREAD), mark unread (add UNREAD), archive (remove INBOX), star (add STARRED), or file mail under a label. Labels are names in any case, or ids from list_labels; unknown names return an error, and create_label makes new ones. Returns the account and the label ids that were added and removed. Only for accounts connected with --labels (otherwise the error says how to enable it). TRASH and SPAM are refused, so nothing can be deleted or marked as spam.

account.description: Which mailbox: email address, alias, or local part. Optional when only one account is connected.

thread_id.description: Change every message in this thread instead.

name: modify_labels
title: Change labels
